summary: PSEG filed a 424B5 pricing supplement for a $650 million offering of 5.400% secured medium-term notes due 2036, priced at 99.986% of par plus accrued interest. Net proceeds to the company are approximately $646 million. The notes are issued in book-entry form under an underwritten offering with multiple dealers. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction by an issuer, not a special situation. No unusual structural features, change of control, or strategic event is present; the filing is purely a financing matter.
